mentions.name: TOKN
mentions.description: TOKN is a fork of toon for KiCad that provides a reduced token format intended for generating schematics using LLMs.
mentions.problem: LLM models could follow the token syntax correctly, but lacked the electronics knowledge to generate schematics.
mentions.source_excerpt: Whilst I created a fork of toon for Kicad (called TOKN (https://www.mikeayles.com/#tokn)), with the intention of using a reduced token format to generate schematics using LLM's, I could get the models to follow the syntax correctly, but they didn't have the knowledge.

evidence.value: Whilst I created a fork of toon for Kicad (called TOKN (https://www.mikeayles.com/#tokn)), with the intention of using a reduced token format to generate schematics using LLM's, I could get the models to follow the syntax correctly, but they didn't have the knowledge.
